from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,tomllib,pytest,os,coverage
class Results:
 def __init__(self): self.rows=[]
 def pytest_runtest_logreport(self,report):
  self.rows.append(dict(test=report.nodeid,phase=report.when,outcome=report.outcome,error=str(report.longrepr) if report.failed else None))
 def pytest_sessionfinish(self,session,exitstatus):
  Path('/reports/owner-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(collected=session.testscollected,exit_code=int(exitstatus),events=self.rows),indent=2)+'\n')
from dank_mids import _requests,_tasks
from dank_mids.helpers import _requester
Path('/reports/owner-module-paths.json').write_text(json.dumps({m.__name__:m.__file__ for m in (_requests,_tasks,_requester)},indent=2)+'\n')
os.chdir('/work/tests/unit')
cov=coverage.Coverage(branch=True,source=['dank_mids'],data_file='/reports/.coverage')
cov.start()
status=pytest.main([],plugins=[Results()])
cov.stop();cov.save();cov.json_report(outfile='/reports/owner-coverage.json')
raise SystemExit(status)
